name: homedata
description: Research UK homes and neighbourhoods by address or postcode: EPC ratings, council tax bands, environmental risks, planning, schools, broadband, crime and area price trends. Lookups consume paid credits from your Homedata account.

interface.longDescription:
Research a UK home or neighbourhood from an address or postcode. Check EPC ratings, council tax bands, flood and other environmental risks, nearby planning applications, schools and Ofsted ratings, broadband coverage, recorded crime and local amenities. Compare area house price trends and deprivation scores, or request a property overview in one call.

Connect a Homedata account to run lookups. Lookups consume paid credits from your Homedata account. Availability varies by property and dataset; schools and deprivation cover England only. Broadband figures describe postcode coverage, and nearby schools do not establish admission catchments. Area price trends do not value an individual home. Homedata does not provide property valuations, homes for sale, or details about owners or occupants.
capabilities: Look up any UK house, flat or address and its UPRN
Full property overview, EPC energy rating and council tax band
Flood risk, radon and other environmental checks for a home
Planning applications, schools and Ofsted ratings nearby
Broadband and full-fibre speeds, crime and local amenities
House price trends, price growth and deprivation by area
defaultPrompt: What's the flood risk at 10 Downing Street, London SW1A 2AA?
Are there good primary schools near SW1A 2AA?
What's the area around M1 1AE like to live in?

review.commerce_description: Lookups consume paid credits from the connected account. Credits are bought outside ChatGPT, and the plugin takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: UK address, property and area lookups for signed-in Homedata users.
